subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd man out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) FHJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/39f868ac6a27dfdec145ab28c19f1d1ca20be788266b0cedb6d42e0a0d587a23.png] 

Option 2) SUV

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/282df09888e0e2771b935d2125a3f06e7fb435e38491ac71842ca4a2238f43ae.png] 

Option 3) HJL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/11b47f8964c859d84f663e9affa180f0ef9712ad707924a3a8739d98a88d42c1.png] 

Option 4) NPR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fcf4dc97c49086fd255da17b8622e64f15a7600f8a46084b5f3694336edc5ac9.png]

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
